_doc: Curated gene lists for the Green Listed symbol box. Built by tools/build_gene_sets.py; do not edit by hand. Lists are per species and every symbol is resolved against that species' built-in libraries, so a list can only ever suggest genes some library can target. These are starting points to edit, not definitive gene families.
